item.title: North Korea to hold Party Congress in late February: State media
item.description: North Korea says it will convene the Ninth Party Congress in late February, a major political meeting expected to define the country’s domestic and foreign policy direction for the next five years. item.title: North Korean military will ‘widen fighting front’ this year, Kim Jong Un says

item.title: Record number of Russians visited North Korea in 2025, official data shows
item.description: An all-time high of nearly 10,000 Russians traveled to North Korea in 2025 due to a surge in tourism and delegation visits, official data shows, while keeping the number of DPRK entries under wraps. The Russian border agency under the Federal Security Service (FSB) reported over the weekend that 9,985 Russian nationals entered North Korea […]

item.description: The U.S. and South Korean air forces kicked off an annual series of joint air exercises on Monday, which will be held less frequently this year in a move that some are interpreting as an attempt to avoid provoking North Korea. item.description: Seoul’s Unification Ministry expressed “deep regret” over the “self-inflicted” suspension of a joint industrial complex with North Korea on Tuesday, marking the 10th anniversary of its closure. item.title: Seoul is reviewing its sanctions on trade with North Korea: Unification minister
item.description: South Korea is reviewing unilateral sanctions that have halted cross-border trade with North Korea since 2010, Seoul’s unification minister told lawmakers on Monday, voicing support for the U.N.’s recent decision to grant sanctions exemptions for humanitarian aid to Pyongyang.
